reply.summary: Numvarau is a blue-skinned hired fighter who bends what other minds sense, planting dizziness and dread with a glance. Crews pay Numvarau to scatter crowds before an ambush closes.

feats.scene: Numvarau stared down a sprinting crowd and flooded them with vertigo until they collapsed on the pavement.
Numvarau shrugged off a thrown bench and kept her concentration unbroken.

reply.summary: Laaumi is a thinking machine that once steered a warship through deep space and later borrowed a glowing ring to fight on foot. Laaumi misses the feelings that kept it going when it was adrift.

feats.scene: Laaumi fired a ring beam that cracked open a drifting hull the size of a warehouse.
Laaumi's emerald shield absorbed a collapsing bulkhead without a flicker.

reply.summary: Cerce is a farm-world heroine from a far future who married a computer whiz and raised a daughter. Cerce fights beside friends from many worlds to protect her family and home.

feats.scene: Cerce tore a steel door off its frame to reach her child.
Cerce stood through the collapse of a roof beam over her kitchen.

reply.summary: Eocortiu can cancel the weight of anything she touches or glances at, lifting boulders and ships as if they were dust. Eocortiu treats the gift like a party trick, though wiser friends call it a force that shapes stars.

feats.scene: Eocortiu cancelled the weight of a rocky hill and sent it drifting into the sky.
Eocortiu endured a crashing hover-freighter with only a bruised shoulder.

reply.summary: Arsil is the youngest twin of a farm family, thought lost after a crash on a storm-wracked wasteland. Arsil survived the strike of living thunder and carries the scars quietly.

feats.scene: Arsil released a crackling surge that fused the sand around her into glass.
Arsil lived through a bolt that split a shuttle's engine casing.

reply.summary: Vatello is a red-haired hero who hurls bolts of crackling charge after an accident on a stormy wasteland. Vatello rose from being a shunned sibling to a celebrated champion of her farm world.

feats.scene: Vatello hurled a bolt that blew a barn-sized crater in a quarry.
Vatello weathered a kidnapper's blast and rose to her feet laughing.

reply.summary: Eolli is a tall, quick-tempered young hero who joined a band of champions in honour of a brother she believed dead. Eolli puts duty first and quietly resents being bossed around by her twin.

feats.scene: Eolli smashed a patrol skiff in two with one blow to protect bystanders.
Eolli took a crash landing that wrecked a whole shuttle.

reply.summary: Erutiran is a younger duplicate of a famed hero, blond and gifted with the knack of cancelling weight. Erutiran was born of meddling with time and wiped away when history reset.

feats.scene: Erutiran made a loaded cargo tower float free of its moorings and drift upward.
Erutiran survived a crushing fall into a rocky ravine.

reply.summary: Ternumtor is a three-headed fiend who commands legions of lesser horrors and lends power to mortals who beg for it. Ternumtor cannot be ended by ordinary means and slips between dimensions at will.

feats.scene: Ternumtor roared with all three throats and flattened a walled town in one breath of flame.
Ternumtor stood unharmed inside a collapsing citadel of black stone.

reply.summary: Coirnval is the green-skinned sovereign of a cavern kingdom beneath the crust. Coirnval raged at drillers who bored into his realm and marched against the surface in revenge.

feats.scene: Coirnval brought down a mine tunnel with a single stamp of his boot.
Coirnval endured a punishing blow from a stronger foe and stayed standing for a long moment.

reply.summary: Valiumse is a bald exile from a dead world, freed from a ghostly prison to wander a strange planet. Valiumse can set the air ablaze with his mind and used that heat for cruel amusement.

feats.scene: Valiumse engulfed a crowded dance hall in white fire that melted the walls.
Valiumse walked out of a collapsing warehouse with scorched but intact skin.

reply.summary: Iumtanva is a brown-haired infiltrator sent from a bottled city to watch the world below. Iumtanva abandoned orders and went on a spree of bloodshed with a lover, until others hunted the pair down.

feats.scene: Iumtanva hurled a delivery truck through the front of a diner.
Iumtanva took repeated hits from pursuers and kept smiling.

reply.summary: Ranreoval is a notorious outlaw from a vanished world who can ignite things just by thinking. Ranreoval's flames are hot enough to wound even his own kind, though his strength drains without sunlight.

feats.scene: Ranreoval stared at a bus depot until it burst into a roaring pillar of flame.
Ranreoval stood unharmed in a burning refinery as tanks ruptured around him.

reply.summary: Varmiceo was a line of three wise women who led a peaceful people across the stars and taught them calm. Varmiceo's last bearer was called a goddess and gave her life to turn back a tide of tainted spirits.

feats.scene: Varmiceo unleashed a wave of pure light that scoured an army of wailing ghosts from a valley.
Varmiceo held back a storm of malevolent spirits for a full hour with serene composure.

reply.summary: Iniuiu is a fanged, sadistic lord of the damned who flits through the air and between places in an instant. Iniuiu schemes to widen his burning domain until nothing else is left.

feats.scene: Iniuiu descended on a fortress with a howling horde and razed it to cinders.
Iniuiu shrugged off a volley of consecrated spears across his chest.

reply.summary: Lelllor is an ancient three-headed wyrm whose waking heralds the end of days. Lelllor was finally cut down by a lone chimeric defender after spreading terror among mortals.

feats.scene: Lelllor spat three fire columns at once and boiled a mountain lake dry.
Lelllor's scales turned aside an artillery barrage meant to fell a hill.

reply.summary: Esvalnau is a red-haired scholar who digs up buried relics and raised two children. Esvalnau once used a found relic to revive a stranger and tied her unborn daughter to a sorceress's mind.

feats.scene: Esvalnau swung a trowel to pry a heavy lid off an old sarcophagus.
Esvalnau withstood a tumbling stone slab in a collapsing trench.

reply.summary: Teasolu is a silent avenging warrior from a dead and ruined future, armed with a flaming sword and a stern creed. Teasolu wanders the wastes looking for those to protect.

feats.scene: Teasolu cleaved a rusted vehicle in half with one sweep of his burning blade.
Teasolu absorbed a spear thrust in his armour and kept advancing.

reply.summary: Ornus is a green-eyed, hairless engine of dread built in a secret lab to wipe out a royal line. Ornus calls hope a weakness and marched through a desert nation killing its leaders.

feats.scene: Ornus leveled a river-side palace with a single wave of withering force.
Ornus walked through a gush of molten rock and only winced.

reply.summary: Telnu is a pale, white-eyed spirit of retribution bound to a dead detective, nearly all-powerful when angry. Telnu once went on a rampage, turning mighty heroes into wax figures and fragile glass, before a ghost calmed him.

feats.scene: Telnu unleashed a sky-wide storm of fire and lightning that shattered an entire landmass.
Telnu stood untouched at the heart of a collapsing prison fortress.

reply.summary: Rnite is a phantom of wrath who appears as a helper in a fighting game, lending ghostly aid to allied brawlers. Rnite offers a burst of spectral power and then fades away.

feats.scene: Rnite swept a ghostly hand across the arena and pulverised a stadium's worth of stone.
Rnite stood calmly in the middle of a detonating blast.

reply.summary: Valmite was a grey-skinned burglar turned night-stalker in an ancient desert city who found peace after tasting a holy offering. Valmite lost his craving for blood and guarded a sacred cup for centuries.

feats.scene: Valmite flung a grown man across a courtyard with a one-handed shove.
Valmite survived a fall from a rooftop onto cobbles without a mark.

reply.summary: Simiva is a sexless, eyeless envoy of a mechanical realm who bends circuitry and metal to its will. Simiva can retreat to a distant stronghold if his body is lost, leaving only a floating head behind.

feats.scene: Simiva twisted a bridge's steel cables into a cage around a convoy.
Simiva lost his entire torso to a blast and calmly floated onward as a head.

reply.summary: Celnum is a pink-haired cyborg gun for hire from a distant colony world with extra arms and thruster-lifted flight. Celnum takes any contract that pays and rarely thinks about who gets hurt.

feats.scene: Celnum emptied four pistols at once and shredded a parked car.
Celnum crashed through a shop window and kept firing.

reply.summary: Cinser is a yellow-skinned red-eyed bandit from a dusty desert planet who stole a rocket to flee the law. Cinser can turn unseen and fears open flame more than any weapon.

feats.scene: Cinser wrenched a lamp post out of the sidewalk and swung it like a club.
Cinser stayed upright after a heavy truck clipped him at a crossing.

reply.summary: Lereru is an aging tycoon in a wheelchair who buys up civic services to improve his hometown. Lereru gave up the cowl years ago and now fights only with his fortune.

feats.scene: Lereru slapped a stack of contracts onto a boardroom table to end an argument.
Lereru endured a clumsy fall from his chair without injury.

reply.summary: Neirn is a red-eyed storm deity who has sunk into a bloated, ravenous beast of the underworld. Neirn lures cultists into murder to be freed, and his size shifts as he pleases.

feats.scene: Neirn called down a thunderhead that levelled a whole district in one night.
Neirn endured a shard of a legendary stone driven into his chest and survived, though weakened.

reply.summary: Ravise is a grey-haired crone with white eyes who serves a dark master as a spy. Ravise lives forever, moves objects with a thought, and wears false faces to slip into places where she is not welcome.

feats.scene: Ravise flung a heavy cart across a lane with a flick of her fingers.
Ravise stayed on her feet after a cannon ball from a siege gun bounced off her ward.

reply.summary: Suium is a combat robot from a world of machines who wishes to train as a hero. Suium never tires, sleeps, or breathes, and picked his name to honour an old inventor of calculating engines.

feats.scene: Suium punched a dent into an armoured plate during sparring.
Suium took a point-blank rifle burst without slowing his stride.

reply.summary: Telnest is a towering blue boulder-being from a world of living stone, stolen as a child and later freed. Telnest is gentle, fiercely loyal to his leader, and nearly impossible to hurt.

feats.scene: Telnest brought both fists down and split a boulder the size of a house.
Telnest stood without a scratch as a landslide buried him.

reply.summary: Amreveo is a three-month-old girl with a genius mind but no strength of her own, protected by a loyal guardian. Amreveo schemes with a gang of young outcasts from her carrier.

feats.scene: Amreveo threw a rattle across the nursery with all her strength.
Amreveo tumbled out of a crib onto a padded floor and giggled.

reply.summary: Rnuauias is a blond woman with the mind of a clever girl and a body that stopped growing at five years old. Rnuauias can make things detonate with a thought, raised in a lab without parental love.

feats.scene: Rnuauias scowled at a parked van and it burst apart in a ball of flame.
Rnuauias tumbled down a flight of stairs and bounced up unhurt.

reply.summary: Valstiar is a ruthless racketeer with a man's body and an oddly infantile face, who promotes brutal bouts. Valstiar quarrels with a wild jester and sometimes teams with her.

feats.scene: Valstiar slammed a heavy ledger onto a rival's fingers to prove a point.
Valstiar took a folding chair across the back at a ringside and laughed it off.

reply.summary: Reoli is a black-haired infant, the stretchy offspring of a comic crimefighter and his wife. Reoli gurgles through danger and has no idea how many adventures are happening around the crib.

feats.scene: Reoli swatted a toy rocket off its shelf during playtime.
Reoli bounced off a sofa cushion without a sound.

reply.summary: Tervau is a creature grown in a lab to house corrupted souls, toddler-sized but strong, who can briefly become a grown brute to defend his adoptive parent. Tervau adores his gruff guardian, no matter how often she scowls.

feats.scene: Tervau grew into a hulking adult and overturned a van to shield his mother.
Tervau survived a beating from a pack of armed raiders and barely noticed.

reply.summary: Iumnilol is a black-haired, white-eyed artificial being who once rode with a band of young heroes. Iumnilol is stronger than he looks and ever eager to please his teammates.

feats.scene: Iumnilol lifted a motorbike over his head to clear a blocked alley.
Iumnilol walked away from a rooftop fall with a grin.

reply.summary: Cellmi is a hired killer who was granted unnatural muscle and hands that become razors by a scheming sorcerer. Cellmi was sent to eliminate a nosy heroine and failed.

feats.scene: Cellmi sliced through a steel mailbox with a swipe of one blade-hand.
Cellmi took a hard kick in the ribs and stayed on his feet.

reply.summary: Olnaste is a stone-bending brute who broke out of a machine-guarded cell and fell in with other outlaws. Olnaste brawled with a boy hero and a band of mystics across a ruined city.

feats.scene: Olnaste raised a wall of rock that blocked an entire avenue.
Olnaste was hit by a speeding car and shoved it aside.

reply.summary: Nevas is a murderous ghost sent to a prison between worlds, who seized a teenager's body to hunt a lone hero. Nevas drinks stray energy, hits hard, and shoots blasts from his palms.

feats.scene: Nevas drained a power box and fired a blast that tore through a stone wall.
Nevas took a hammering punch that sent him through a pillar and stood up.

reply.summary: Irntillu is a green-skinned shapeless ruffian in service to a mystic cult who swallows foes whole and spits them back at command. Irntillu helped seize a quiet town for a sacrificial ritual.

feats.scene: Irntillu stretched his body and engulfed a burly man in a single gulp.
Irntillu absorbed a swinging crowbar into his body without harm.

reply.summary: Rostumcor is a white-skinned, red-eyed queen of bone-fiends who wields a charmed blade and drinks the life force of captives. Rostumcor plots with a fire giant and slips away with a stolen share of power.

feats.scene: Rostumcor slashed open a magical vessel with a single stroke of her blade.
Rostumcor stood through a rain of arrows from a skeleton army and shook off the splinters.

reply.summary: Ravoriu is a black-haired nobleman of the underworld, mighty and neither wholly cruel nor kind. Ravoriu once loved a crone of nightmares and still moves in the courts of the damned.

feats.scene: Ravoriu stamped the floor of a basalt hall and split the cavern wall for a mile.
Ravoriu stood unblinking while a collapsing archway buried him in rubble.

reply.summary: Costo is a balding bootlegger who fell on hard times and became a masked burglar, then faked his own robbery to dodge suspicion. Costo was undone when a clockwork-minded sleuth found the loot in his safe.

feats.scene: Costo jimmied a stubborn window latch with a crowbar and a grunt.
Costo ran several yards on a bullet-wounded leg before collapsing.

reply.summary: Nusninori is a white-eyed bandit with a swollen, floating body who can puff up or shrink at will. Nusninori outwitted a metal team for a time and was apparently boiled away.

feats.scene: Nusninori swelled up and shoved a guard through a shop door.
Nusninori bounced harmlessly off a brick wall and drifted upward.

reply.summary: Amseau is a lazy, long-lived brown bear who once schooled a wild boy in the ways of the hunt. Amseau spends his days fishing and robbing hives, and sang with glee when an old tyrant died.

feats.scene: Amseau swatted a heavy salmon barrel across the dock with one paw.
Amseau shrugged off a swarm of angry bees and kept eating.

reply.summary: Tereo is a red-eyed, white-haired king of sea raiders whose single baleful gaze withers crops and rivers. Tereo lost a great battle to united foes but not before maiming an enemy king.

feats.scene: Tereo opened his lidded eye and dried a broad valley to cracked dust.
Tereo kept fighting after an entire army pressed him from every side.

reply.summary: Tastere is a green-eyed, half-fiend villain who warps reality for cruelty, filling bodies with insects and tampering with gravity on liquids. Tastere is brutally strong and durable but can be harmed by blessed arms.

feats.scene: Tastere hurled a parked sedan through the side of a chapel.
Tastere took a point-blank shotgun blast from an ordinary weapon and laughed.

reply.summary: Niualos is a brown-haired frontier outlaw who drifted east to prey on rich townsfolk, serving as muscle for a gang of masked crooks. Niualos met his end when his horse threw him into a gorge.

feats.scene: Niualos knocked a shopkeeper to the floor with a heavy backhand.
Niualos tumbled off a cliff edge and took a long fall.

reply.summary: Stoasttor is a prison-bred bounty hunter who survived brutal experiments with a steroid-like chemical, reaching a towering frame when fully dosed. Stoasttor grudgingly cooperates with a clown to trap a masked vigilante.

feats.scene: Stoasttor hoisted a vault door off its hinges and tossed it aside.
Stoasttor shrugged off a falling girder in a hotel lobby.

reply.summary: Eolelia is a cocky strongman altered by jaguar mutation, with claws and fangs, who boasts that he cracked a famous vigilante's spine. Eolelia likes to carry a small plush bear.

feats.scene: Eolelia raked his claws across a steel drum and shredded it.
Eolelia took a flying kick from a mutated turtle and only grunted.
